parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the plugin list. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
The plugin source. Valid values:

- USER: custom plugin
- SYSTEM: system preset plugin
